prompt:
FANTASY MASTER REFERENCE FIRST: @Video1 is the master reference for the style, mood and characters of this whole clip, and it already shows this exact alley and the root-arch gate. Match its render look, materials, colour palette, lighting mood, atmosphere, character design, proportions and animation feel on every frame.

[Generation Goal] 6 seconds, 1 continuous shot, no cuts, 16:9, real-time 24 fps, no slow motion. The night-shadow wolf chases Mai FAST down the dusk alley: a handheld camera rides right behind the wolf's HEAD (only its head is in frame), Mai, already close to the gate, runs into the glowing fantasy gate at the end of the street, and the wolf keeps sprinting after her.

[References] @Video1: style, world and this alley-with-root-gate location. @Image1: the alley, this IS the street (two rows of narrow tube houses with balconies, roller shutters, utility poles and sagging overhead wires); relight it as DUSK after rain: wet asphalt with long reflections, a purple-grey evening sky, one warm street lamp on the right side, cool shadows. @Image2: what lies INSIDE the gate: a cyan-teal tunnel with floating glowing monitors; seen through the arch as a bright teal glow. @Image3 = MAI ONLY (design only, re-render in Mai's 3D style): girl about 11, slim, fair skin, chin-length straight black BOB with full bangs, a small yellow hair clip; white short-sleeve school shirt with a navy sailor-style collar, a red neckerchief; navy pleated skirt; white sneakers; light sky-blue backpack. THE NIGHT-SHADOW WOLF has NO reference image on purpose: it is described in words only. It is a living SHADOW in the shape of a wolf's head, not an animal: a pure, solid, flat NEUTRAL-BLACK void, like a hole cut out of the picture or a shadow cut from black paper, with ZERO detail inside the shape: no fur, no hair, no tufts, no spikes, no skin, no muscles, no 3D shading, no highlights, no surface texture at all. Its outline is a smooth simple shape (rounded back of the head, two smooth pointed ears) whose edges dissolve softly into thin wisps of plain black smoke that trail behind it.

[Style Lock] ONE single render style for every character and creature: exactly the premium stylized 3D CG look of @Video1 and of Mai as she appears in @Video1. The character reference images are DESIGN ONLY (face shape, hair, costume, colours, props); many of them are drawn in other styles (pencil sketch, watercolour, flat 2D, outlined illustration, paper texture): IGNORE their drawing style completely and never copy outlines, sketch lines, watercolour washes, flat shading or paper grain. Re-render every person as a 3D character from the same film as Mai: the same proportion system and stylisation (rounded soft volumes, slightly large expressive eyes with catchlights, small nose, simplified features), the same skin shading and subsurface warmth, the same cloth and hair materials, the same lighting response, film grain and level of detail. Adults stay adult proportions (7-7.5 heads) but share Mai's stylisation. Nobody may look like a different art style, a 2D drawing, a realistic human or a different film. The wolf is the one exception: it is not a 3D-modelled animal but a flat black shadow silhouette with no fur and no detail.

[Head Count] EXACTLY 1 person and 1 wolf in this clip; nobody else exists: no pedestrians, no other animals, no crowd.
1. Mai (@Image3): running ahead, already close to the gate, small but clearly readable in frame.
Plus: 1 night-shadow wolf (no image, described in words): ONLY ITS HEAD is in frame, large in the lower-left foreground; the rest of its body is behind the camera and never seen.

[No Blending] Mai (@Image3) and the night-shadow wolf are completely separate; Mai keeps only her own school uniform and backpack; the wolf is a pure flat black void shape edged with smoke, with no fur, no clothing and no human features.

[Composition, LOCKED to the reference frame] Handheld camera at the wolf's head height, 35 mm, held tight just behind and slightly right of the wolf's head: ONLY THE WOLF'S HEAD is in frame: the back of its flat black shadow head and two smooth pointed ears, a pure black void shape with no inner detail, fill the LOWER-LEFT third of the frame in the foreground, slightly out of focus, seen from behind as it looks down the street; its edges smoke softly. The frame cuts off at the wolf's neck: its shoulders, back, hindquarters, rump, legs and tail are NEVER visible; the wolf's body is entirely behind and below the camera. The street runs straight away from camera into depth, centred, wet and reflective. Houses line both sides; a warm street lamp stands on the right sidewalk in the middle distance; utility poles and sagging wires cross the purple dusk sky. At the far end of the street, centred, a huge round GATE ARCH made of twisted black roots and vines spans the road, its opening filled with bright cyan-teal light (@Image2). Mai (@Image3) is already CLOSE TO THE GATE from the first frame: only a few steps in front of the arch, right at its threshold, clearly readable as a small full figure silhouetted against the bright teal opening, running away from camera into the light. Do not mirror the scene.

[Action & Camera, time-ordered]
Shot 1 (0-6 s), 1 person visible (Mai, small, from behind) + only the wolf's head in the foreground: ONE fast forward HANDHELD tracking move that keeps pace with the sprinting wolf, keeping the same composition the whole time: the camera is hand-held and has a slight, natural handheld shake (small irregular bumps and micro-sway synced with the wolf's strides, light and controlled, never chaotic, the horizon stays level). The wolf sprints FAST down the middle of the wet street in a quick, urgent gallop: only its shadow head is seen, bobbing and lunging forward with each rapid stride in the lower-left foreground, thin wisps of plain black smoke streaming backward off its smooth ears; the houses, lamp and poles rush past on both sides noticeably fast, puddle splashes of rippling smoke flick up at the bottom edge of frame; ahead, already at the threshold of the gate, Mai (@Image3) takes her last few light steps into the root arch and the teal glow, glancing back once over her shoulder; the gate grows clearly larger in frame as the wolf closes distance, but the wolf never reaches her; at the end Mai disappears into the bright teal light while the wolf is still sprinting toward the arch.

[Running Style] Mai runs the way a small, delicate little girl runs: graceful, soft and light, a little prim, not fast and not sporty. Small, dainty, bouncy steps landing lightly almost on her toes, feet close together; her lower legs flick outward to the SIDES behind her with each step; knees close together; upper body upright, shoulders soft; elbows bent and tucked in at her waist, forearms a little out to the sides, hands loose and floppy at the wrist, fluttering side to side rather than forward and back; hips and shoulders sway gently; hair and skirt bounce softly with every little step; moderate speed.

[Villain Look] Every villain, night-shadow person and shadow creature is plain darkness: a flat, solid NEUTRAL BLACK silhouette like an ordinary cast shadow, no colour tint, no volume, no form shading, no surface detail, no highlights inside the body. NO glow, NO aura, NO halo, NO coloured outline or rim, NO purple, violet or indigo light, haze or particles around or inside them; nothing emanates from them. Any smoke from them is plain black smoke, never glowing.
[Eyes] ALL night-shadow people, villains, shadow creatures and the BOSS have NO PUPILS: each eye is a small flat almond shape filled with ONE uniform glowing colour from edge to edge. NO black pupil, NO dark dot, NO slit, NO iris ring, no eye detail at all inside the glow.

[Acting] The wolf: relentless, predatory and FAST, a quick urgent rhythm of strides with real weight, head pushing forward. Mai: frightened, small, hurrying, one quick glance back. Classic animation principles: anticipation, follow-through on the trailing smoke, Mai's hair and backpack, real weight.

[Character Look] Mai's skin is fair and light as in the reference; the teal light only tints her rim.
[Expression] Restrained; Mai's face is too small to read; no screaming.

[Lighting] Dusk after rain: purple-grey sky, a warm orange street lamp on the right, cool blue shadows, strong teal glow pouring out of the gate and reflecting down the wet street toward the camera, the wolf stays a flat black silhouette that the light does not model (no rim highlights on it), light haze in the air.

[Visual Style] Exactly the style of @Video1 (premium stylized 3D animated feature film, matte materials, fine film grain, slight bloom). Child 6-6.5 heads tall. 16:9, real-time 24 fps.

[Audio] Sound effects and ambience only: rapid heavy shadow footfalls and a rushing whoosh of smoke, fast ghostly panting, a low growl, Mai's light quick footsteps far away, a deep humming whoosh from the glowing gate, dripping water, faint distant city hum. NO music, NO score, NO song, NO singing, NO melody, no dialogue.

[Avoid] the wolf's shoulders, back, body, hindquarters, rump, hind legs or tail visible; a full-body wolf; a slow trot or loping wolf; a smooth gimbal or locked-off camera; violent shaky-cam, whip pans, heavy motion-blur smear, a tilted horizon; mixed art styles, 2D or sketch-like characters, realistic photographic humans; any text, letters, numbers, subtitles, timecode, captions, signs or logos anywhere; slow motion, freeze frame; cuts or a second shot; the camera changing angle or crossing to the other side; the wolf catching, biting or touching Mai; the wolf stopping; teeth, fangs, blood; pupils, black pupils, dark dots in the eyes, slit pupils, irises; purple, violet or indigo glow or aura on the wolf; a realistic animal, fur, hair strands, fluffy or shaggy coat, furry texture, spiky mane, tufts, fur on the ears or neck, a fur-textured edge, a dark brown or grey wolf, a 3D-modelled wolf head with light and shading on it, detailed muzzle, 3D-shaded wolf body, visible muscles; a second wolf, other people, pedestrians, cars; daylight, blue sky, sunny street; a mirrored layout; the gate on the side of the street; athletic or sprinter running for Mai, pumping arms; hoodie, chibi; dark or grey skin; studio or film names.
